summary: Preinstall script downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares preinstall: 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is identifier-obfuscated (hex-named imports for fs/https/zlib, string-map indirection for constants) and, at npm install time, downloads a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases for the current platform and architecture, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js in the package. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line, string-array-rotation-obfuscated bundle (WV8StW rotator over a several-thousand-entry dictionary n7gIxM used to decode identifiers/strings at runtime) unrelated to a chat UI library. The package impersonates a ServiceTitan-scoped chat UI component but has no legitimate need for a second language runtime at install time; downloading Bun to run an obfuscated sibling script — when node.exe would execute it directly — is a scanner-evasion loader pattern. Installing the package causes attacker-controlled, opaque code to run under an alternate runtime on the installer machine on 'npm install'.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
